Format Premiere - Coruscant: the list plays Coruscant cards (Tatooine (Coruscant), Insurrection & Aim High, Your Insight Serves You Well & Staging Areas).
Posted 'Tatooine (Coruscant)' dested the Light Coruscant-set Tatooine (the strategy says it is for free Hyper Escape); 'Tatooine Cantina' dested Tatooine: Cantina (Light).
Posted 'Red Squadron One' dested Red Squadron 1 (Death Star II); the draft had Red Squadron 7.

Posted 'YISYW/Staging Areas', 'Insurrection/Aim High', 'Control/Tunnel Vision', 'AWRI/Darklighter Spin', 'Houjix/Out Of Nowhere' and 'OOC/TT' dested the combo cards; 'Ill Take The Leader' dested I'll Take The Leader; 'X-Wing Laser Cannons' dested X-wing Laser Cannon.
Posted 'Correlia', 'Millenium Falcon', 'Tallon Karde', 'Run Luke, Run' and 'WED-9-M1 'Bantha Droid' dested Corellia, Millennium Falcon, Talon Karrde, Run Luke, Run! and WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid.

Posted 'Han w/ Gun', 'Chewie w/Gun', 'Lando w/ Gun', 'Luke w/ Lightsaber', 'Cpt. Han Solo' and 'Threepio w/ Parts Showing' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Chewie With Blaster Rifle, Lando With Blaster Pistol, Luke With Lightsaber, Captain Han Solo and Threepio With His Parts Showing.
